shortBlurb: One standard company system for construction subcontractors: log work, capture photos and receipts, clock in with GPS, submit weekly.
featureBullets: Allocated work and job details in one place
Daily site records with hours, work and delays
Timestamped photos linked to each job
Materials and receipts filed by job
Weekly invoices with CIS and clear status
Office dashboard to review, query and pay
